approvals.note: Leif approved this bug fix's scope himself on 2026-11-13 after the coordinator agent's (claude-code-t370) summary: a requirement whose SHALL sits at a line edge counts as a normative statement; any whitespace sets SHALL off. Prepared and recorded by claude-code-t38p.

approved_scope.title: A requirement whose SHALL sits at a line edge counts as a normative statement
approved_scope.description: A requirement whose SHALL sits at a line edge counts as a normative statement
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: A requirement must contain a normative SHALL statement; a SHALL that a line break sets off, at the end or start of a wrapped line, is that statement, and validate_requirement refused it because it looked only for a space on each side (#1076)
acceptance_criteria: a requirement whose SHALL ends or starts a wrapped line is accepted; a requirement with no SHALL is still refused with the normative SHALL message

relayed_by.words: Asked 'SpecSync bug fix #1076: a correctly worded requirement got refused when a line break fell right before or after its SHALL. Any whitespace counts now. Approve?', he chose "Approve (Recommended)".
